name: Finger-Licking Chicken Pittas
method: Mix the yoghurt, tomato puree and tikka paste in a bowl, add the chicken strips and toss to coat. Cover and chill for 15 minutes.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over a medium heat and add the oil.
Stir-fry the chicken for 5 to 8 minutes until cooked through but still juicy.
Warm and split the pittas, fill with shredded lettuce and the chicken, and serve with the halved cherry tomatoes.
